lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Hi there! Welcome to Fit Life. How can I help you today?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 핏 라이프에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to sign up for a membership.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Great! We have monthly and yearly memberships. How long would you like to sign up for?
lines.ko: 좋아요! 월 회원권과 연 회원권이 있어요. 얼마 동안 등록하시겠어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like a monthly membership, please.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: A monthly membership is fifty thousand won. Have you exercised at a gym before?
lines.ko: 월 회원권은 5만 원이에요. 전에 헬스장에서 운동해 보셨어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, but it's been a long time.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: No problem! Many people start again here. What's your goal? Losing weight, or getting stronger?
lines.ko: 괜찮아요! 여기서 다시 시작하시는 분들이 많아요. 목표가 뭐예요? 살 빼기요, 아니면 근력 키우기요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I want to lose weight and get stronger. I used to go biking after work.
lines.ko: 살도 빼고 튼튼해지고 싶어요. 예전에는 퇴근하고 자전거를 탔어요.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Biking is great cardio! We also have indoor cycling classes. Would you like a personal trainer to help you?
lines.ko: 자전거는 정말 좋은 유산소 운동이죠! 실내 사이클 수업도 있어요. 개인 트레이너 도움을 받으시겠어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'd like a personal trainer. I'd like to learn step by step.
lines.ko: 네, 개인 트레이너가 있으면 좋겠어요. 차근차근 배우고 싶어요.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Great! Our trainer, Mike, is very kind. A personal training session is thirty thousand won. How many times a week would you like to come?
lines.ko: 좋아요! 저희 트레이너 마이크가 정말 친절해요. 개인 수업은 한 번에 3만 원이에요. 일주일에 몇 번 오시겠어요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to come three times a week.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Three times a week. Perfect! What time would you like to come? Morning or evening?
lines.ko: 일주일에 세 번이요. 좋아요! 몇 시에 오시겠어요? 아침이요, 저녁이요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to come in the evening after work.

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: OK! Mike is free at seven p.m. on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. Does that work for you?
lines.ko: 알겠어요! 마이크가 월, 수, 금 저녁 7시에 시간이 돼요. 괜찮으세요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I usually finish work at seven p.m. Is anyone free at seven thirty?
lines.ko: 제가 보통 7시에 퇴근해요. 7시 반에 시간 되는 분 있나요?

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Let me check... Yes! Our trainer Sarah is free at seven thirty. She's great with beginners. Shall I book her for you?
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요… 네! 트레이너 사라가 7시 반에 시간이 돼요. 초보자를 정말 잘 가르쳐요. 사라로 예약해 드릴까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, please. Can I start tomorrow?
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 내일부터 시작할 수 있어요?

lines.name: Chris
lines.en: Sure! Your first session is tomorrow at seven thirty. Don't forget to bring comfortable clothes and water. See you tomorrow!
lines.ko: 그럼요! 첫 수업은 내일 7시 반이에요. 편한 옷이랑 물 꼭 챙겨 오세요. 내일 봬요!

vocab.meaning: 회원 등록을 하다 (등록하다 = sign up / join)
vocab.example: I'd like to sign up for a membership.
Yes, but it's been a long time.
I want to lose weight and get stronger.

vocab.meaning: 자전거 타러 가다 (go a biking ✕ / go + -ing)
vocab.example: I used to go biking after work.
I'd like to come three times a week.
I usually finish work at seven p.m.
Mike is free at seven p.m. Does that work for you?
